none: PAS SUSS-34DD71: Roman Coin: Radiate of Gallienus (Sole Reign)
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman radiate coin of Gallienus (sole reign, AD 260-268). Reece Period 13; mint unknown. The surface of the coin is extremely worn but it is possible to depict a radiate bust facing right with the features of Gallienus and a standing female figure on the reverse. Obverse legend reads: [...] AVG. The reverse legend is illegible. Some circumferential losses are evident, in addition to surface wear
